This topic is part of the Cambridge IGCSE GCSE German specification.

Area B: Personal and Social Life appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The Cambridge IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area B: Personal and Social Life.
